name: crew
description: Cheap headless workers through three agent CLIs without fighting Claude's harness: Claude writes the task, sets scope and gate and reviews the diff; the worker runs one slice under its own CLI's hooks, installed for the run only. Backends: agy (Antigravity, Gemini; default), opencode 2.x (free Zen models, weaker shell guard) and GitHub Copilot CLI (no shell, paid in AI credits). The verdict never reads the CLI's exit 0 as success.
